Explicit analytic prerequisite restatement:
E has the same finite real Hilbert/Borel/full-space structure including dimension zero. Source V is C2 with all-point/all-direction alpha I<=Hess V<=beta I, alpha,beta NNReal, 0<alpha<=beta, eta>0 and beta eta<=1.
Actual common Gibbs/Gaussian augmentation J and Markov disintegrating R/S are constructed. S_y=(2x-y)#R_y is precisely volume.tilted(-W_y), W_y(z)=V((y+z)/2)+norm(z-y)^2/(8eta), with true C2 regularity and positive integrable partition.
For every y one original dense closable compact-smooth gradient D_y with closed closure is fixed before epsilon/input. For each epsilon>0 and true f in L2(S_y), one u/G/r serves all compact sets, ordinary tests and all C2 compact cutoffs. Existence is fiberwise; no jointly measurable solution selector, RGO operator identity or localized weighted-domain membership is concluded.
From actual source V/alpha/beta/eta construct true common augmentation R/S and reflected law, and for each y the original dense closable D_y before epsilon/forcing. Construct one actual u before all cutoffs in that same closure domain. Retain the actual all-domain variational equation, ordinary locally integrable u/G, all C1 compact directional weak-gradient tests, squared local integrability of r=epsilon*u+inner(grad W_y,G)-f, compact-volume L2 of u/G/r and every C2 original distribution test. For every C2 compact chi define v=chi*u, Gchi=chi*G+u*grad chi, Fchi=chi*r+2 inner(grad chi,G)+u Delta chi. Prove genuine global-volume L2 of v/Gchi/Fchi and each topological support contained in tsupport chi. For every C1 compact psi/direction a both weak-gradient products are L1 with integral psi inner(Gchi,a)=-integral v Dpsi[a]. For every C2 compact phi both PDE products are L1 with integral v Delta phi=integral Fchi phi. The same u is chosen before all cutoffs; only smooth test/cutoff functions have classical derivatives. Reflected and unreflected RGO laws/operators/scales remain distinct.
Same actual original D/u/G/r, one u before all C2 compact chi: derive actual compact support/global volume L2 of chi*u, chi*G+u*gradchi, chi*r+2<gradchi,G>+u*Delta chi, all C1 compact weak-gradient and C2 compact distribution PDE with every L1 term legal. No localized weighted closure-domain membership, H2, Schwartz/tempered adapter, global core/Bochner, BL/Poincare, epsilon0, noncompact domain, measurable y-selector or either main/composition. Reflected/RGO law/scale remain distinct; TV never transfers unbounded expected cost.

{E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {V : E → ℝ} {α β : NNReal} {η : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < (α:ℝ)) (hαβ : α ≤ β) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)
    (hH : ∀ x v : E, (α:ℝ)*‖v‖^2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ≤ (β:ℝ)*‖v‖^2)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hβη : (β:ℝ)*η ≤ 1) :
    let μ := (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun x => -V x)
    let J := Measure.map (fun p : E × E => (p.1,p.1+Real.sqrt η • p.2)) (μ.prod (stdGaussian E))
    let W := fun y u : E => V ((1/2:ℝ) • (y+u)) + ‖u-y‖^2/(8*η)
    ∃ R S : Kernel E E, IsMarkovKernel R ∧ IsMarkovKernel S ∧
      (J.map Prod.swap).IsCondKernel R ∧
      (∀ y, S y = (R y).map (fun x => (2:ℝ) • x-y)) ∧
      ∀ y, S y = (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun u => -W y u) ∧
        ContDiff ℝ 2 (W y) ∧ Integrable (fun u => Real.exp (-W y u)) ∧
        0 < (∫ u, Real.exp (-W y u)) ∧
        ∃ D : Lp ℝ 2 (S y) →ₗ.[ℝ] Lp E 2 (S y),
          Dense (D.domain : Set (Lp ℝ 2 (S y))) ∧ D.IsClosable ∧ D.closure.IsClosed ∧
          (∀ (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) (v : Lp E 2 (S y)), (u,v) ∈ D.graph ↔
            ∃ f : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ f ∧ HasCompactSupport f ∧
              u =ᵐ[S y] f ∧ v =ᵐ[S y] gradient f) ∧
      ∀ (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ∀ f : Lp ℝ 2 (S y),
      ∃ u : D.closure.domain,
        (∀ v : D.closure.domain,
          ε * ⟪(u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)), (v : Lp ℝ 2 (S y))⟫ +
            ⟪D.closure u, D.closure v⟫ = ⟪f, (v : Lp ℝ 2 (S y))⟫) ∧
        LocallyIntegrable (fun x => (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x) ∧
        LocallyIntegrable (fun x => D.closure u x) ∧
        (∀ ψ : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → ∀ v : E,
          Integrable (fun x => ψ x * inner ℝ (D.closure u x) v) ∧
          Integrable (fun x => (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x * fderiv ℝ ψ x v) ∧
          (∫ x, ψ x * inner ℝ (D.closure u x) v) =
            - ∫ x, (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x * fderiv ℝ ψ x v) ∧
        LocallyIntegrable (fun x => ‖ε * (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x +
          inner ℝ (gradient (W y) x) (D.closure u x) - f x‖ ^ 2) ∧
        (∀ K : Set E, IsCompact K →
          MemLp (fun x => (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x) 2 (volume.restrict K) ∧
          MemLp (fun x => D.closure u x) 2 (volume.restrict K) ∧
          MemLp (fun x => ε * (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x +
            inner ℝ (gradient (W y) x) (D.closure u x) - f x) 2 (volume.restrict K)) ∧
        (∀ φ : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 2 φ → HasCompactSupport φ →
          Integrable (fun x => (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x * Laplacian.laplacian φ x) ∧
          Integrable (fun x => (ε * (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x +
            inner ℝ (gradient (W y) x) (D.closure u x) - f x) * φ x) ∧
          (∫ x, (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x * Laplacian.laplacian φ x) =
            ∫ x, (ε * (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x +
              inner ℝ (gradient (W y) x) (D.closure u x) - f x) * φ x) ∧
        ∀ χ : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 2 χ → HasCompactSupport χ →
    let v := fun x => χ x * (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x
    let Gχ := fun x => χ x • D.closure u x + (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x • gradient χ x
    let Fχ := fun x => χ x * (ε * (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x + inner ℝ (gradient (W y) x) (D.closure u x) - f x) + 2 * inner ℝ (gradient χ x) (D.closure u x) +
      (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x * Laplacian.laplacian χ x
    MemLp v 2 volume ∧ MemLp Gχ 2 volume ∧ MemLp Fχ 2 volume ∧
    tsupport v ⊆ tsupport χ ∧ tsupport Gχ ⊆ tsupport χ ∧ tsupport Fχ ⊆ tsupport χ ∧
    (∀ ψ : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → ∀ a : E,
      Integrable (fun x => ψ x * inner ℝ (Gχ x) a) ∧
      Integrable (fun x => v x * fderiv ℝ ψ x a) ∧
      (∫ x, ψ x * inner ℝ (Gχ x) a) = -∫ x, v x * fderiv ℝ ψ x a) ∧
    ∀ φ : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 2 φ → HasCompactSupport φ →
      Integrable (fun x => v x * Laplacian.laplacian φ x) ∧
      Integrable (fun x => Fχ x * φ x) ∧
      (∫ x, v x * Laplacian.laplacian φ x) = ∫ x, Fχ x * φ x
decoder_context: E is a finite-dimensional real inner-product space with Borel measurable space and canonical Lebesgue volume, including dimension zero. All section ambient instances remain part of the contract. NNReal means nonnegative real scalars.

Lp F 2 mu is the true L2 quotient and its coercion selects the standard measurable representative. MemLp is actual a.e. strong measurability and finite L2 norm. All compact restrictions in the statement use volume.restrict K, and all unannotated local integrability/integrals use canonical volume.

gradient is the Riesz representative of actual Frechet derivative; fderiv is total Lean derivative. Laplacian.laplacian phi is the actual test-function finite-basis trace. The theorem only tests arbitrary L2 u against this smooth-test Laplacian, and does not assert pointwise total laplacian u.

LinearPMap is a real-linear partial operator on its submodule domain, with actual graph. IsClosable means its topological graph closure is single-valued. D.closure is that same closed operator. Its L2 output is the actual G representative; the localized Gchi is explicitly chi*G+u*gradient chi, without any weighted-domain assertion.

Measure.tilted h means exp(h)/integral exp(h) times the original measure; it does not build in positive normalization. Kernel IsMarkovKernel means genuine measurable probability transitions. IsCondKernel is true disintegration of the stated joint measure. Measure.map/prod mean actual pushforward/independent product. stdGaussian is the genuine standard real Hilbert Gaussian. ContDiff 1/2/infinity means C1/C2/smooth; HasCompactSupport is compact topological support.

theorem conditional_localized_resolvent {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {V : E → ℝ} {α β : NNReal} {η : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < (α:ℝ)) (hαβ : α ≤ β) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)
    (hH : ∀ x v : E, (α:ℝ)*‖v‖^2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ≤ (β:ℝ)*‖v‖^2)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hβη : (β:ℝ)*η ≤ 1) :
    let μ := (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun x => -V x)
    let J := Measure.map (fun p : E × E => (p.1,p.1+Real.sqrt η • p.2)) (μ.prod (stdGaussian E))
    let W := fun y u : E => V ((1/2:ℝ) • (y+u)) + ‖u-y‖^2/(8*η)
    ∃ R S : Kernel E E, IsMarkovKernel R ∧ IsMarkovKernel S ∧
      (J.map Prod.swap).IsCondKernel R ∧
      (∀ y, S y = (R y).map (fun x => (2:ℝ) • x-y)) ∧
      ∀ y, S y = (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun u => -W y u) ∧
        ContDiff ℝ 2 (W y) ∧ Integrable (fun u => Real.exp (-W y u)) ∧
        0 < (∫ u, Real.exp (-W y u)) ∧
        ∃ D : Lp ℝ 2 (S y) →ₗ.[ℝ] Lp E 2 (S y),
          Dense (D.domain : Set (Lp ℝ 2 (S y))) ∧ D.IsClosable ∧ D.closure.IsClosed ∧
          (∀ (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) (v : Lp E 2 (S y)), (u,v) ∈ D.graph ↔
            ∃ f : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ f ∧ HasCompactSupport f ∧
              u =ᵐ[S y] f ∧ v =ᵐ[S y] gradient f) ∧
      ∀ (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ∀ f : Lp ℝ 2 (S y),
      ∃ u : D.closure.domain,
        (∀ v : D.closure.domain,
          ε * ⟪(u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)), (v : Lp ℝ 2 (S y))⟫ +
            ⟪D.closure u, D.closure v⟫ = ⟪f, (v : Lp ℝ 2 (S y))⟫) ∧
        LocallyIntegrable (fun x => (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x) ∧
        LocallyIntegrable (fun x => D.closure u x) ∧
        (∀ ψ : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → ∀ v : E,
          Integrable (fun x => ψ x * inner ℝ (D.closure u x) v) ∧
          Integrable (fun x => (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x * fderiv ℝ ψ x v) ∧
          (∫ x, ψ x * inner ℝ (D.closure u x) v) =
            - ∫ x, (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x * fderiv ℝ ψ x v) ∧
        LocallyIntegrable (fun x => ‖ε * (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x +
          inner ℝ (gradient (W y) x) (D.closure u x) - f x‖ ^ 2) ∧
        (∀ K : Set E, IsCompact K →
          MemLp (fun x => (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x) 2 (volume.restrict K) ∧
          MemLp (fun x => D.closure u x) 2 (volume.restrict K) ∧
          MemLp (fun x => ε * (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x +
            inner ℝ (gradient (W y) x) (D.closure u x) - f x) 2 (volume.restrict K)) ∧
        (∀ φ : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 2 φ → HasCompactSupport φ →
          Integrable (fun x => (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x * Laplacian.laplacian φ x) ∧
          Integrable (fun x => (ε * (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x +
            inner ℝ (gradient (W y) x) (D.closure u x) - f x) * φ x) ∧
          (∫ x, (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x * Laplacian.laplacian φ x) =
            ∫ x, (ε * (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x +
              inner ℝ (gradient (W y) x) (D.closure u x) - f x) * φ x) ∧
        ∀ χ : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 2 χ → HasCompactSupport χ →
    let v := fun x => χ x * (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x
    let Gχ := fun x => χ x • D.closure u x + (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x • gradient χ x
    let Fχ := fun x => χ x * (ε * (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x + inner ℝ (gradient (W y) x) (D.closure u x) - f x) + 2 * inner ℝ (gradient χ x) (D.closure u x) +
      (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x * Laplacian.laplacian χ x
    MemLp v 2 volume ∧ MemLp Gχ 2 volume ∧ MemLp Fχ 2 volume ∧
    tsupport v ⊆ tsupport χ ∧ tsupport Gχ ⊆ tsupport χ ∧ tsupport Fχ ⊆ tsupport χ ∧
    (∀ ψ : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → ∀ a : E,
      Integrable (fun x => ψ x * inner ℝ (Gχ x) a) ∧
      Integrable (fun x => v x * fderiv ℝ ψ x a) ∧
      (∫ x, ψ x * inner ℝ (Gχ x) a) = -∫ x, v x * fderiv ℝ ψ x a) ∧
    ∀ φ : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 2 φ → HasCompactSupport φ →
      Integrable (fun x => v x * Laplacian.laplacian φ x) ∧
      Integrable (fun x => Fχ x * φ x) ∧
      (∫ x, v x * Laplacian.laplacian φ x) = ∫ x, Fχ x * φ x := by
  obtain ⟨R,S,hR,hS,hcond,hSR,hfiber⟩ :=
    AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.ProximalBPS.ConditionalGradient.conditional_gradient_closable hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη
  dsimp only
  refine ⟨R,S,hR,hS,hcond,hSR,?_⟩
  intro y
  obtain ⟨hSy,hW,hI,hZ,D,hDense,hClose,hClosed,hgraph⟩ := hfiber y
  refine ⟨hSy,hW,hI,hZ,D,hDense,hClose,hClosed,hgraph,?_⟩
  intro ε hε f
  let Wy : E → ℝ := fun u => V ((1/2:ℝ) • (y+u)) + ‖u-y‖^2/(8*η)
  have hW1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 Wy := hW.of_le (by norm_num)
  have hwc := AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.FunctionalInequalities.LocalizedWeakResolvent.localized_weak_resolvent Wy hW1 hI
  dsimp only at hwc
  rw [← hSy] at hwc
  exact hwc D hClose hgraph ε hε f

end AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.ProximalBPS.ConditionalLocalizedResolvent
